title: 2 weeks since I started making my Multiplayer Survival RPG (Stewards of the Keep)
author: IcyBother8850
selftext:
In 2 weeks with AI managed to create authoritative server, client, vertical slice with brand new test 3D models  (floor tile, Character and a sword). Sword that attaches to each hand, also placeholder UI with functional inventory where you can move items around...honestly I'm kinda mind blown with the progress. 

Code is libGDX(Java) done 99% with prompting Codex on GPT 5.6 Luna  
Concept Pictures with chatGPT then into Meshy for 3D Models/Rigs/Animations then Blender for normalization + adding hand sockets for weapons.

I am still far away from getting the ring to Mordor but at least I have left the Shire it seems :)

P.S. If you wanna chat or ask any questions you can find me on my discord: [https://discord.gg/7gDb7CR8S](https://discord.gg/7gDb7CR8S)
